name: Flurrie · Gremlet #1
description:
A snowball bunny with icicle ear-tips and a scarf it never takes off.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Flurrie in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
